providers.name: GitHub
checklist: Create or verify the production GitHub OAuth app.
Install GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET as Cloudflare Worker secrets.
Complete hosted sign-in through GitHub and verify the dashboard session resolves the signed-in user.
